newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iraq to buy $306 mln wheat, $115 mln sugar -Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Iraq to buy $306 mln wheat, $115 mln sugar -Turkey.

text.p: Turkey, which hopes to get a big share in supplying Iraq's needs under the U.N. oil-for-food deal, said on Friday Iraq was expected to import wheat worth $306 million and sugar worth $115 million.

The foreign trade undersecretariat (DTM) said in a note to Turkish exporters that Iraq would also buy liquid food oil worth $111 million, rice worth $105 million, lentils $102 million, tea $32 million, milk powder $29 million and $5 million of other food items. The total food purchases will be worth $805 million.
Iraq will spend about $210 million for medical supplies, $65 million for soap and other hygiene materials, and $230 million for other material for civilian use, it said.
It did not give other details.
An escrow account to be opened in Banque National De Paris BNP.PA (BNP) will collect all money from the oil sales.

Some of the proceeds will be allocated for the U.N. compensation fund and its personnel, leaving Iraq $1.31 billion of the total oil sales to spend for humanitarian needs. --Ercan Ersoy, Ankara Newsroom, 90-312-4462940
